description: This file defines a React component called PasswordStrengthMeter that visually indicates the strength of a password based on a score. It uses Material-UI components and styling to display a progress bar and descriptor text, with internal logic to determine the display based on the score.

classes.name: PasswordMeter
classes.description: Interface representing the properties of the password strength meter, including progress, color, and descriptor.

methods.name: isPasswordBlank
methods.description: Type guard function to check if the score is undefined, indicating a blank password.

methods.name: calculatePasswordMeter
methods.description: Function that returns the PasswordMeter object based on the provided score, or a default for blank passwords.

methods.name: PasswordStrengthMeter
methods.description: React functional component that renders the password strength indicator, including a progress bar and descriptor text.
